hints.title: Movement Rules
hints.text: Armies can only move between a friendly fort 1 and an empty fort -1.

hints.title: Continuous Enemy Chain
hints.text: All intermediate positions between 1 and -1 must consist strictly of enemy forts 0.

hints.title: Contiguous Segment Scan
hints.text: Scan the array tracking the index of the last non-zero element. When opposite non-zero types meet, the distance minus 1 gives enemy forts captured.

hints.title: Fort Interval Scanning Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass tracking previous non-zero position.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Examining all pairs of endpoints takes O(n^2).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identifies that captured segments are delimited by opposite non-zero values with only zeroes between them.
